protocol.pairwise_objective: Relative squared error between predicted and observed differences for two actions from one verified prestate
protocol.selection: Lowest combined validation objective; evaluation not used for checkpoint selection

finding: Pairwise supervision improved validation but did not establish held-out action grounding: paired action swaps slightly outperform correct actions, and evaluation pixel error worsens relative to the original objective. The default objective rerun reproduced the earlier correct-action and swap scores exactly.
limitations: This 16x16 grayscale, 136-row selected synthetic archive is unlike the large-scale visual pretraining in the cited work; their results do not transfer to this implementation by citation alone.
Pairs were selected for distinct visual outcomes, so this is not an unbiased task-success estimate.
Task-family evaluation was previously inspected. The opt-in loss and weight are exploratory, not a preregistered model selection result.
No live Heliox model, execution authority, safety gate, real desktop transfer, or Jev parity is established.
